title: Very thick
text: Very thick. Holy cow, this is some thick paper and a heavy roll. The paper is almost like working with leather. There is a lot of footage on a roll. It is easy to peel off and doesnt go wonky and stick to itself. I did however have a spot that it was " torn". along an edge. If you want to make it easy to use, roll the paper in the opposite direction to streighten it up a bit...but remb it is thick. It sticks very well when it is on what you put it on.
